Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseChance_toolti: Percent of the zombies killed that are marked to get back up, 0 to 100, rolled for each zombie. It applies while no other mod drives rising: a mod that does, such as a day and night mod, sets its own share and when corpses get up, by day, night or event, and this option rests meanwhile. Whatever the share, Bandits never rise, nor does a zombie whose head Zombie Dismemberment took off or one with both arms off and a leg lost, and the options below keep others down.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseDelayMin_tool: In-game hours, 0 to 48, from a zombie's death until its corpse may get up, if it was marked to rise when it died. Each corpse gets a time picked at random between this and Rise after at most. Corpses are checked every 10 in-game minutes, and one that rises stands up within seconds. While a mod that drives rising keeps corpses asleep, by day for example, a due corpse waits until it lets them get up; a corpse in an area no player has loaded waits until one does.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseDelayMax_tool: In-game hours, 0 to 48: the latest a marked corpse comes due after its death. Below Rise after at least, the two are swapped and the log warns once; equal to it, every corpse comes due exactly then.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_MaxRises_tooltip: How many times one body can rise, 1 to 20, or 0 for no limit (the default). The count goes with the body: on its corpse, and on the zombie that rises from it. The game keeps nothing of a zombie it unloads, when the zombie walks out of the loaded area, at a restart and at a single player load, so the mod keeps the count meanwhile: a zombie in the same outfit that comes back within 20 tiles of where it was last seen takes it up again.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseMaxAgeHours_t: A marked corpse whose zombie died more than this many in-game hours ago stays down, 0 to 8760 (a year); 0 for no limit. A check drops it, and dragging it later doesn't bring it back unless this has been raised or set to 0 since. A corpse that has turned into a skeleton rises as one.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseWarning_toolt: On: a corpse that is about to get up groans first, and every player near it hears it; it gets up Warning time later. Nothing tells which corpses will rise before that. Off, for hardcore games: corpses get up without a sound.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseWarningMinute: In-game minutes from a corpse's groan until it gets up, 1 to 10. At the default day length of one hour, an in-game minute is 2.5 seconds, so 2 is 5 seconds.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_FireStaysDown_too: On: a zombie that dies of fire is never marked to rise: one that dies burning, on a square with a fire, or by a hit from a weapon that starts fires, such as a molotov or an incendiary bomb, whose hit can kill before it burns. A corpse burned with petrol and a lighter stays down either way, even where no fire can start.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_FinishOff_tooltip: On: right-clicking zombie corpses offers Finish off for the nearest one not yet finished off, as the game's own corpse options pick one. The player walks up to it and finishes it off, and it never rises again; with several such corpses on its tile, it finishes off all of them. Each corpse can be finished off once, by anyone, and it is offered on every corpse not yet finished off, so the menu doesn't show which ones would rise. With Zombie Dismemberment and its decapitation on, Finish off takes the head off, and with it hats, glasses and masks. The server takes it only from a player within 3 tiles of the corpse. Off: only burning, burying or carrying a corpse away keeps it down, and head kills when that option is on.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_FinishOffSeconds_: How long Finish off takes, in seconds at normal game speed, 1 to 30.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_HeadKillsStayDown: On: a zombie killed by a blow to the head stays down. That is a shot the shooter's game puts in the head, a melee hit the game lands on the head (it picks the spot of each melee hit itself: one hit in 7, and a third of critical hits besides), the knife stab through the jaw, and a melee hit to the head of a zombie on the floor within 5 seconds of its death. On a server, the attacker's game also reports the head shots and jaw stabs that killed, and the server takes the report only from the player who killed that zombie; it takes a floor head hit only from a player within 3 tiles. Only the blow that kills counts.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiseInSafehouses_: Off: a corpse that would rise inside a claimed safehouse stays down instead. On: it rises like any other.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RisePlayers_toolt: On: a zombie that was a player can be marked to rise when it is killed, like any other. Off: it stays down.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RisesPerScan_tool: Most corpses that rise in one check, every 10 in-game minutes, on the whole server, 1 to 100; a check searches around for at most five times this many corpses that aren't where they died, and the rest wait for the next. Corpses in areas no player has loaded wait without using this up.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_RiserLimit_toolti: Most marked corpses kept waiting to rise, 100 to 50000; above it the oldest is dropped and stays down, even if it is dragged later. The same number of risen zombies keep their count while the game has them unloaded; above it, the one not seen the longest starts over.
Sandbox_RelentlessDead_Verbose_tooltip: Writes each death with its roll, each rise, every corpse kept down and every Finish off to the log, prefixed [RelentlessDead]. Warnings and errors are always logged.
